items.quote: 4:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text says the LORD spoke to Moses, which introduces the rules that follow.

items.quote: 4:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
items.claim: Moses is told to tell the children of Israel about a case: a person who breaks one of the LORD's prohibitions through ignorance, meaning without intending to.
items.object: the children of Israel; a soul sinning through ignorance
items.mechanism: conditional law covering unintentional breaking of the LORD's prohibitions

items.quote: 4:3 If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people;
items.claim: The law covers a specific case: the anointed priest sins, and his sin counts as the sin of the people.
items.object: according to the sin of the people
items.mechanism: the anointed priest's sin is linked to the people's guilt

items.quote: then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
items.claim: The fix required when the anointed priest sins is to bring a young bullock without blemish to the LORD as a sin offering.
